baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu llāhu ... anuṭʿimu.
baseline_models.mechanism: An allotted gift becomes an entrusted flow: provision reaches holders, expenditure carries a share outward, and feeding realizes it at another body.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure sends wealth out and supplies the transfer step.
An apportioned gift marks what is held as received rather than self-originated.
Feeding another names the recipient-side realization of the outgoing share.

changed_reading.before: Give some food to a needy person.
changed_reading.after: Pass onward as feeding part of the allotment God has already routed through you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The objection man law yashāʾu llāhu aṭʿamahu.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative substitutes divine capacity for commanded human action: because God can directly cause feeding, the speakers deny being intermediate agents.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing supplies the counterfactual capacity on which the refusal turns.
The paired sayings form a negotiation in which a command is answered by a rival account of agency.
The same other-directed feeding is assigned either to the addressees or exclusively to God.

changed_reading.after: God's ability to feed directly is made into a reason that provision-holders should not serve as feeding agents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Alladhīna kafarū ... in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīn.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering the gift publicly redescribe its requested transfer as the believers' exposed misdirection; the countercharge protects withholding.

activation_trace.role: Covering a blessing supplies the economic texture of receiving provision while refusing its acknowledgment.
Deviation from the intended route is the label attached to the believers.
Manifest disclosure makes the countercharge emphatically public and supposedly self-evident.

changed_reading.before: They reject charity and insult the believers.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal covers the received gift by publicly relabeling its onward transfer as manifest deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly nests divine production inside human work, possession, use, and gratitude, so human feeding is a mode of providence rather than a competitor to it.

activation_trace.role: The focus command requires a holder to make wealth leave as support.
The transferred material remains framed as God's apportioned gift.
Intentional human work participates in the production of what is eaten.
What hands earn supplies a concrete human link inside divinely generated fruitfulness.
Acknowledging the gift names the demanded response to eating and hand-work.
Divine creation supplies livestock before human possession or use.
Human ownership and disposal coexist with divine origination rather than replacing it.
Divine enabling makes difficult resources usable by human agents.
Actual eating is the bodily endpoint of the created, owned, and enabled resource.

structural_cues: 36:33-35 moves from divine enlivening and bringing-forth to human eating, hand-work, and gratitude.
36:71-73 repeats divine creation, human ownership and use, eating, benefits, and the gratitude question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested divine creation, human work, possession, use, and gratitude; I infer that feeding is one intended handoff within that nested agency. A live alternative is that these passages illustrate provision generally without specifying charity.

changed_reading.before: Either God feeds the person or humans do.
changed_reading.after: The command names ordinary providence's next human act: divinely created and enabled goods become owned and worked in human hands, then feed another in grateful acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated will-conditionals distinguish sovereign capacity from the presently sustained arrangement: God could drown, erase sight, or transform, yet mercy leaves people able to act.

activation_trace.role: The refusers turn divine willing into an exemption from their commanded action.
A parallel conditional presents drowning as something God could will without saying that it is the current arrangement.
Lethal drowning makes the unrealized alternative concrete rather than norm-setting.
Mercy names the actual preservation that follows the drowning counterfactual.
The same will formula introduces another unrealized removal of agency.
Erasure of sight specifies a capacity God has not enacted in their present moral situation.
A third conditional keeps divine capacity distinct from the actual field of action.
Transformation in place would remove mobility, highlighting the mobility and agency presently retained.

structural_cues: 36:43-44 pairs an if-We-will catastrophe with actual mercy and temporary benefit.
36:66-67 repeats if-We-will twice for unrealized losses of sight and movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capability conditions contrasted with actual preservation, sight, and mobility; I infer that could-will-X does not itself define the present norm or erase commanded agency. A live alternative treats every human act only as an ultimate divine act and rejects this modal distinction.

changed_reading.before: If God has the power to feed directly, humans bear no feeding responsibility.
changed_reading.after: The objection confuses counterfactual sovereign capacity with the actual merciful arrangement in which provision-holders remain able and commanded to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact error formula already belongs to the believer's rejection of false worship, then a straight path is contrasted with Satan's mass misleading; the focus accusation is therefore a contested seizure of the surah's route-language.

activation_trace.role: The refusers assign deviation from the right route to the believers.
They claim that the alleged deviation is manifest.
The earlier believer uses the same deviation term for the route of taking other gods.
The exact manifest-error pairing establishes a deliberate verbal echo.
The straight road supplies the positive route against which error is measured.
Uprightness and balance sharpen the contrast with straying.
Later misleading is assigned to the hostile route, reversing the focus speakers' placement of error.
Reason that restrains ignorance challenges the rational pose of the focus objection.

structural_cues: 36:24 and 36:47 repeat the exact pair fī ḍalālin mubīn from opposing mouths.
36:60-62 identifies the manifest enemy, the straight path, and the source of widespread misleading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact echo and the later route contrast; I infer that the focus charge is deliberately contested and reversed rather than narrator-endorsed. A live alternative is simple reuse of a polemical formula without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The believers are plainly deluded for asking others to feed.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a seized label: refusers call generosity clear error, while the surah's route-map relocates error to the misleading allegiance behind refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The public theological reply becomes an accountable economic act: dispute is interrupted, mouths are sealed, hands speak about acquisition, and both concealed and declared content remain known.

activation_trace.role: The focus reply is argumentative negotiation over who must act.
Covering supplies a possible relation between the declared rationale and what it protects.
Disputation continues until the sudden interruption, placing a limit on verbal defense.
The preventing seal removes the mouth's control of the account.
Intelligible speech transfers from the disputing mouth to the acting hand.
The hand as bodily agent becomes the witness against a merely verbal account.
Testimony discloses action by knowledge rather than assertion.
Acquiring livelihood and benefit reconnects judgment to the economics of retained provision.
Hidden inward content keeps the stated objection from exhausting the act's meaning.
Public disclosure names the outward side represented by their spoken rationale.

structural_cues: 36:49 catches them in dispute, while 36:65 transfers speech from sealed mouths to hands concerning what was earned.
36:76 places their speech beside what they conceal and what they disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-action audit and a hidden-versus-public contrast; I infer that the focus rationale may cover retention of acquired provision. A live alternative is a sincere deterministic argument that is still judged through its economic action.

changed_reading.before: The speakers advance a detached theological proposition.
changed_reading.after: Their proposition is also an accountable act of retention: the mouth's rationale can be displaced by what the provision-acquiring and provision-withholding hand has done.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present benefit lasts only to a term, and the sudden blast closes even the ability to transmit a testament to one's family; expenditure is therefore a voluntary transfer available only while agency remains open.

activation_trace.role: The going and ending of a thing gives expenditure a temporal as well as economic edge.
Voluntary outgoing wealth is the action available in the focus present.
Useful provision for needs is explicitly framed as temporary equipment.
A bounded time gives the useful provision an endpoint.
Loss of ability closes the former field of voluntary action.
An intended transfer of obligation or property can no longer be carried onward.
The family destination makes the failed post-interruption transfer socially concrete.

structural_cues: Immediately after 36:47, 36:49-50 interrupts dispute and removes the ability to make a bequest or return to family.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporary benefit, sudden interruption, and inability to bequeath; I infer that the expenditure command is a now-open disposition window. A live alternative takes the sequence only as eschatological warning, without a specific wealth-timing implication.

changed_reading.before: Spend because another person presently needs food.
changed_reading.after: Spend while transfer is still possible; delayed stewardship can become an unmade bequest when the holder's agency closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends the tunnel-or-outlet image of n-f-q into the surah's ecology. It remains anchored in anfiq, provision, and feeding, and is triggered by grain brought out of earth and springs split open. Render it only as a material analogy, not as a replacement etymology for expenditure.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating passage with an outlet turns spending into an image of opening a route through held resources.
Life-giving descent widens provision from private stock to an ecological supply.
Grain exits dead earth as the first visible release in the nourishment chain.
Springs split open and issue outward, adding a second material outlet.
Eating supplies the bodily endpoint toward which the successive releases move.

changed_reading.before: A holder gives from a static stock.
changed_reading.after: Provision is a linked outlet system: earth releases grain, springs release water, and the holder is asked to become the next opening through which nourishment reaches a body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the final creator formula to a social imperative. It remains anchored in qīla, anfiqū, divine willing, and feeding. Render it as a reader-supplied agency analogy only: it neither identifies the unspecified focus speaker with God nor claims that command guarantees human obedience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū ... law yashāʾu llāhu aṭʿamahu.

activation_trace.role: The focus opens with an uttered command and then records the uttered refusal.
The commanded effect requires human expenditure as its responsive means.
Command as demand or obligation supplies an enacted form of authority.
Divine intention supplies the willing side of the final formula.
Will reaches toward an effect through saying, making command a possible mode of mediation.
Coming into occurrence supplies the effect-side of willing speech.

changed_reading.before: If God willed, He would feed without involving us.
changed_reading.after: The command spend may itself be one means by which divine willing addresses human agents and brings feeding into occurrence.

strongest_changes: Provision shifts from zero-sum divine-versus-human agency to mediation through created goods, ownership, work, and gratitude.
Repeated divine-will counterfactuals distinguish sovereign capacity from the actual moral arrangement and undercut the excuse.
The clear-error charge reverses under the surah's earlier and later route language.
Immediate interruption turns expenditure into a time-bounded chance to transfer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition linked provision, hands, will-conditionals, accusation labels, and final creative speech without collapsing them into one reading; the outlet-chain and command-as-means readings remain deliberately exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the refusal's theology is sincere or functions chiefly as a cover for retaining goods.
How far the hand and ownership cluster licenses stewardship rather than only a general illustration of provision.
Whether the outlet and final-command analogies should surface in prose or remain diagnostic.
